blocks.tagline: What you draw, in one line

tiers.name: Something else
tiers.blurb: Backgrounds, group pieces, anything not listed

blocks.heading: Terms
blocks.text: Say when payment is due, how long a commission usually takes, and at what stage you send a preview so revisions can happen. State it plainly: a surprise about any of these is the complaint you will get.

blocks.heading: What I will and will not draw
blocks.text: Write two short lists here: what you are happy to take on, and what you are not. A few examples on each side are enough for people to tell quickly whether their idea fits.

blocks.heading: How to order
blocks.text: Message me with what you want, which tier it is, and any references. I will confirm the price before you pay.
